Module: include/Clock.h
Types:
- class Clock { public: virtual ~Clock() noexcept; virtual std::string now() const = 0; } Semantics: Abstract boundary for obtaining a timestamp string; callers must not assume any format beyond stable string; no OS/time access.
- class FixedClock : public Clock { public: explicit FixedClock(const std::string& ts); std::string now() const override; } Semantics: Returns the fixed timestamp provided at construction; deterministic for tests.
Allowed includes: Users include include/Clock.h where a Clock is needed. FixedClock is part of the same header.

Module: include/VersionHistory.h
Types:
- struct VersionEntry { std::string timestamp; std::string description; } Semantics: Immutable record entry; timestamp is derived from Clock::now(), description is caller-provided.
- class VersionHistory { public: void append(const Clock& clock, const std::string& description); const std::vector<VersionEntry>& entries() const noexcept; std::size_t size() const noexcept; std::string toString() const; } Semantics: Append-only container; append pushes a new VersionEntry with timestamp=clock.now() and the given description; entries() returns a const reference to an internal vector (do not mutate); size() returns number of entries; toString() builds a stable human-readable representation with one line per entry formatted as "timestamp - description" ordered by append order.
Allowed includes: include/VersionHistory.h may be included by PressRelease and tests. It includes include/Clock.h for Clock reference.

Module: include/TemplateEngine.h
Types:
- struct SubstitutionResult { std::string output; std::vector<std::string> missingKeys; } Semantics: output is the rendered text; missingKeys lists unique placeholder keys encountered that were not found in fields.
- class TemplateEngine { public: SubstitutionResult render(const std::string& tmpl, const std::map<std::string,std::string>& fields) const; } Semantics: Renders tmpl by substituting tokens of the form {{key}}; keys may contain dots to represent nesting like contact.email; if a key is missing from fields, the token is left unchanged in output and the key is added to missingKeys; stable deterministic behavior; no recursion or computation beyond direct lookup.
Allowed includes: Self-contained; used by Renderer and tests.

Module: include/Validator.h
Types:
- struct ValidationResult { bool ok; std::vector<std::string> errors; } Semantics: ok is true when there are no errors; errors lists human-readable messages.
- class Validator { public: ValidationResult validateFields(const std::string& headline, const std::string& body, const std::string& email, const std::string& phone) const; } Semantics: Rules: headline and body must be non-empty; email must contain one '@' and at least one '.' after '@'; phone must contain at least 7 digits (ignores non-digits). Returns errors for each rule violated; ok is false if any errors.
Allowed includes: Self-contained; used by PressRelease and tests.

Module: include/PressRelease.h
Types:
- struct Contact { std::string name; std::string email; std::string phone; } Semantics: Contact information.
- enum class LifecycleState { Draft, InReview, Published }; Semantics: State machine values; initial state is Draft.
- class PressRelease { public: explicit PressRelease(const std::string& id); std::string id() const; std::string headline() const; std::string body() const; Contact contact() const; LifecycleState state() const noexcept; const std::set<std::string>& tags() const; void setHeadline(const std::string& value, const Clock& clock, const std::string& desc); void setBody(const std::string& value, const Clock& clock, const std::string& desc); void setContact(const Contact& contact, const Clock& clock, const std::string& desc); void addTag(const std::string& tag, const Clock& clock, const std::string& desc); void removeTag(const std::string& tag, const Clock& clock, const std::string& desc); bool submitForReview(const Validator& validator, const Clock& clock, const std::string& desc); bool publish(const Validator& validator, const Clock& clock, const std::string& desc); std::map<std::string,std::string> toFieldMap() const; const VersionHistory& history() const; } Semantics: Holds id, headline, body, contact, tags, and lifecycle state. Mutators set fields and record history via VersionHistory::append(clock, desc). addTag inserts tag into set (idempotent) and records history; removeTag erases if present and records history. submitForReview: allowed only from Draft; validates headline, body, and contact; on success, transitions to InReview and records history; returns true on transition, false otherwise (no exception). publish: allowed only from InReview; validates again; on success, transitions to Published and records history; returns true on transition, false otherwise. toFieldMap: returns a map with keys: "id", "headline", "body", "contact.name", "contact.email", "contact.phone", "state" (string form: "Draft", "InReview", "Published"), and "tags" as a comma-separated, deterministic lexicographically sorted list.
Allowed includes: include/PressRelease.h includes include/VersionHistory.h, include/Validator.h, and include/Clock.h; no circular dependencies.

Module: include/Renderer.h
Types:
- class Renderer { public: std::string render(const std::string& templateTxt, const PressRelease& pr, const TemplateEngine& engine) const; } Semantics: Composes TemplateEngine with PressRelease by calling engine.render(templateTxt, pr.toFieldMap()) and returns SubstitutionResult.output; missing key reporting is left to callers if needed.
Allowed includes: include/Renderer.h depends on include/TemplateEngine.h and include/PressRelease.h.

Module: include/SearchIndex.h
Types:
- struct ReleaseRecord { std::string id; std::string headline; std::string body; std::set<std::string> tags; } Semantics: Snapshot of published or review-ready press release for indexing.
- class SearchIndex { public: void add(const ReleaseRecord& rec); void clear() noexcept; std::vector<ReleaseRecord> search(const std::string& textQuery, const std::set<std::string>& requiredTags) const; } Semantics: add appends to internal store; clear empties records; search performs case-insensitive substring match of textQuery within headline or body and ensures requiredTags is a subset of rec.tags; returns results in insertion order; pure logic.
Allowed includes: Self-contained; used by runtime and tests.

Module: src/*.cpp implementations
- src/Clock.cpp: Implements FixedClock::FixedClock and FixedClock::now; no side effects.
- src/VersionHistory.cpp: Implements append(), entries(), size(), toString(); toString stable line-per-entry format.
- src/TemplateEngine.cpp: Implements render(); deterministic parsing, collects missing keys, leaves unknown tokens intact.
- src/Validator.cpp: Implements validateFields(); aggregates messages and sets ok accordingly.
- src/PressRelease.cpp: Implements constructors, accessors, mutators, lifecycle gating, toFieldMap, history accessor; no exceptions on invalid transitions; returns bool.
- src/Renderer.cpp: Implements render(); returns engine.render(...).output.
- src/SearchIndex.cpp: Implements add/clear/search; case-insensitive comparison using std::tolower; tags subset check.

Module: src/Main.cpp
- Runtime entrypoint demo: Constructs FixedClock("2024-01-02T10:00:00Z"), PressRelease("PR-001"), sets fields/tags, constructs Validator, transitions through InReview and Published if valid, constructs TemplateEngine and Renderer to render a template, constructs SearchIndex, adds record, performs a search, prints version history and search results; exits successfully; headless and deterministic.

Build and test protocol:
- CMakeLists.txt must create a core library from all src/*.cpp except src/Main.cpp, link runtime and tests to that library, call enable_testing(), and register tests with add_test().

Allowed import/include direction:
- include/Clock.h has no dependencies on project headers.
- include/VersionHistory.h may include include/Clock.h.
- include/TemplateEngine.h is standalone.
- include/Validator.h is standalone.
- include/PressRelease.h may include include/Clock.h, include/VersionHistory.h, include/Validator.h.
- include/Renderer.h may include include/TemplateEngine.h and include/PressRelease.h.
- include/SearchIndex.h is standalone.
Tests must include only headers from include/*.h and must not include any src/*.cpp files. All public signatures above are canonical; callers and tests must use exactly these names and types.

20260914182157.json.Shared Knowledge: This repository defines a core C++17 library with domain modules in include/*.h and src/*.cpp pairs: deterministic Clock boundary, append-only VersionHistory, TemplateEngine for placeholder substitution, Validator for basic field rules, PressRelease entity with lifecycle and history, Renderer composing press release with template, and SearchIndex for audience tags and text search. src/Main.cpp is a thin, deterministic runtime demo. tests/test_main.cpp includes only declared headers and links against the core library. CMake builds a reusable core library from src/*.cpp (excluding src/Main.cpp), links runtime and test targets, and registers a single test with CTest.
Test Scope Plan: runtime wiring: construct objects, perform Draft->InReview->Published transitions under valid data, render template, index record, and perform a search
template substitution: render with fields and verify output contains substituted headline and contact.email; missing key detection returns expected missingKeys
lifecycle gating: ensure publish() returns false when validation fails (e.g., invalid email) and state does not change
search behavior: case-insensitive contains and tag inclusion; query matches headline/body and respects requiredTags
